load_budget_a.operating_case: Four analog microphones and four ADC channels at 96 kHz, 128 BCLK/FSYNC, PLL on, DRE/AGC off; RT1062 active native-flash read; separate flash program/erase peak; Board A 5-V receiving envelope 4.5-5.5 V, local ambient -40..85 C
load_budget_a.classification: Manufacturer maximum values are used only under their stated test conditions. Other figures are enforceable design allocations, not guaranteed silicon consumption maxima.

load_budget_a.protection: TPS62135 internal 4.8-6.5 A switch limit/hiccup and TPS7A20 360-730 mA output limit are regulator self-protection, not load-safe branch limits. A hard fault can dissipate far above continuous budgets; input-source current limit, trace/fuse coordination and downstream branch safety must be completed before schematic release.
unclosed_exact_items: Manufacturer-guaranteed TLV320ADC5140 AVDD/IOVDD current at four-channel 96 kHz and 128 BCLK/FSYNC is absent; imposed 50/5-mA ceilings require acceptance and R14 measurement.
TPS62135 guaranteed minimum efficiency or maximum total conversion loss for 4.5-5.5 V, 350 mA and forced PWM is absent; 70% is an acceptance assumption, not a guaranteed thermal bound.

Selected capacitor MPNs with guaranteed effective capacitance at bias/temperature/tolerance and selected inductors' hot Isat/DCR must be frozen; local buck and internal-DCDC stability/current peaks must be checked.
Product-board effective theta-JA, enclosed local ambient and high-load LDO ground current are not guaranteed by the cited device tables; thermal screening is conditional.
Upstream 5-V receiving/current-limit and fault-energy contract is a separate Board B/interface obligation, outside this Board A subtask.

power_tree.rt1062_hardware_guide: NXP MIMXRT105060HDUG Rev 7 pp.2-6: SNVS before/tied HIGH; DCDC_PSWITCH RC 5-15 ms, >=1 ms post DCDC stable; 4.7-10 uH Isat >1 A ESR <0.2 ohm; 33 uF DCDC output; Table 2 decoupling. Component selection/derating pending.

r4a_selected_circuit.mcu_3v3_buck: TPS62135RGXR, forced PWM, 255-kohm top/68.1-kohm bottom 1% divider, 1-uH XAL4020-102MEC candidate, effective output 22-200 uF and effective input >=3 uF required
r4a_selected_circuit.adc_afe_3v3_ldo: TPS7A2033PDQNR from received 5 V, >=1-uF effective input/output capacitors
r4a_selected_circuit.mic_2v8_ldo: TPS7A2028PDQNR from MCU_3V3, >=1-uF effective input/output capacitors
r4a_selected_circuit.flash_1v8_ldo: TPS7A2018PDQNR from MCU_3V3, >=1-uF effective input/output capacitors
r4a_selected_circuit.flash_core_current: ISSI IS25WP064A Rev A11 section 9.3: normal read at 50 MHz <=12 mA, program/status-write/erase <=30 mA at 125 C; read output-switching and flash I/O loads are excluded, so total rail maximum remains open
r4a_selected_circuit.rt1062_dcdc: 30-kohm 1% and 0.22-uF 10% DCDC_PSWITCH RC; XFL4020-472MEC 4.7-uH inductor; >=33-uF effective DCDC_OUT/VDD_SOC_IN total plus NXP HW7 Table 2 pin-local capacitors
r4a_selected_circuit.por_supervisor: TPS389030DSER monitors MCU_3V3; RESET open drain to POR_B with 10-kohm pullup to tied SNVS/HIGH_IN; MR is reserved for other-rail valid gate, not yet proven; 10-nF 10% CT gives 7.8-15.8-ms calculated release-delay component bound
r4a_selected_circuit.snvs: Tie VDD_SNVS_IN to VDD_HIGH_IN; no backup battery
r4a_selected_circuit.adc_96khz_typical_context: TI SBAA379 Table 1: four-channel 96-kHz, PLL enabled, DRE disabled, linear phase, 24-bit, 96 BCLK/FSYNC gives 25.68 mA typical AVDD at 3.3 V; excludes I/O and is not a maximum. Selected BCLK/FSYNC=128 point is uncharacterized for maximum current. The former 100-mA LDO screen left 2.64 C reference-board margin; section load_budget_a now imposes a 75-mA rail ceiling with 10.15 C conditional reference-board margin.
r4a_selected_circuit.mcu_current_context: NXP AN12245 Table 8 EVK XIP rail currents are board measurements, not guaranteed maxima; use CEC rated rail currents plus allocated I/O loads for engineering budget.
